representations.name: log-defect coarea filtration
representations.new_information: retains the entire distribution of w_N across an edge rather than only its total or maximum
representations.first_test: embed balanced-padded minimal circuits below every positive defect cutoff and determine which coarea rules collapse to a hard threshold

representations.name: signed prime-incidence circuit matrix
representations.new_information: keeps every valuation row and the {-1,0,1} circuit orientation, including reused primes and support minimality
representations.first_test: derive arbitrary signed minimality of graph edge-prime circuits and test whether a circuit cocircuit can canonically expose one vertex

representations.name: active-prime hyperedges and cardinality strata
representations.new_information: represents each squarefree-above-y integer by the set of its active primes and records its active degree
representations.first_test: check exact single-degree admissibility, then attack unions of adjacent degrees with K_(s+1,s) circuits

representations.name: largest-prime fibre DAG with residue state
representations.new_information: orders active primes while retaining the lower-prime cofactor left after a top valuation balance
representations.first_test: quantify how a balanced top fibre transfers a multiplicative residue to lower fibres and search for a bounded ownership load

representations.name: Buchstab smooth-rough recursion
representations.new_information: separates the negligible smooth core, repeated-large-prime exception, and squarefree active-prime incidence by a movable y=N^(1/L)
representations.first_test: prove the exact exceptional-set cost and identify a recursion whose congestion is sublogarithmic rather than merely restating incidence balance

representations.name: arithmetic failure-event dependency graph
representations.new_information: retains which bad circuits share actual integers or valuation fibres under randomized deletion
representations.first_test: bound or refute the weighted dependency neighborhood after truncating the smooth core and short circuits

representations.name: exponential-clock witness ownership
representations.new_information: assigns each circuit to a random minimum vertex and exposes the exact probability/load with which one integer owns some circuit
representations.first_test: compute ownership on padded edge-prime circuits, overlapping bicircuit books, and multi-scale prime fibres

representations.name: local rank and coarea of valuation support
representations.new_information: replaces global exponent rank by rank accumulated across prime scales and charges only rank increments
representations.first_test: contrast rank-one powers-of-two Schur triples with high-rank single edge-prime circuits and locate a weight-compatible local rank

representations.name: profinite cylinder with stabilizing deletion states
representations.new_information: tracks decisions as the controlled prime set grows and makes cross-cylinder relations explicit
representations.first_test: prove or refute stabilization and zero upper-density deletion for a finite-state prime exposure rule

representations.name: ordered greedy certificate DAG
representations.new_information: records a concrete witness relation whenever a descending or largest-prime greedy rule rejects an integer
representations.first_test: seek an injective or bounded-load map from rejection certificates to log-defect mass and test it on circuit books

representations.name: multiplicative energy primal-dual packing
representations.new_information: pairs a transversal candidate with packings of minimal bad circuits to test whether any proposed loss is sharp
representations.first_test: construct disjoint and highly overlapping padded circuits and compare integral hitting cost with fractional defect mass

representations.name: canonical factor tree and recursive token balance
representations.new_information: factors each rough integer by its largest active prime and carries balanced-cardinality tokens with their cofactors instead of discarding residues
representations.first_test: write the exact recursion for a two-level active-prime relation and test whether token states grow or admit a bounded potential
